description: Ministry of Energy - Ceylon Petroleum Corporation Act. No. 28 of 1961 Revise the Fuel Price Effective from 12.00 Midnight on October 31st 024
reasoning: This gazette contains an order issued under the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation Act, No. 28 of 1961, revising fuel prices. It constitutes a regulatory action where the Minister exercises statutory powers to modify pricing regulations. This falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it involves the implementation and modification of existing legislation through statutory instruments.
